{
 "path": "programs/task-5309cfd6.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Shear the nonzero figure leftward row by row, anchoring its bottom."""
    cells = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(r for r, _, _ in cells)
    out = [[0 for _ in row] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])
    for r, c, v in cells:
        nc = c + r - bottom
        if 0 <= nc < width:
            out[r][nc] = v
    return out
"
